notes: The customer app's bundle budget (ADR-0052 §The bundle budget, inherited at D12.1 — ADR-0055 §3 says the mechanism lands with the app rather than being acquired later).
Bytes are GZIPPED, which is what a browser downloads; `pnpm size` measures dist/ and fails the gate when a number here is exceeded.

js = every JavaScript byte the build emits. css = every CSS byte. entry = the module script dist/index.html loads, the chunk paid before anything renders. chunks = one ceiling per vendor chunk in dist/assets/vendor/ (D14.9).
Raising a budget is a deliberate diff of this file that someone reviews — that is the whole mechanism. Lowering one after a real saving is just as welcome.
The headroom over the baseline is the admin's: about 8% on js and entry, about 11% on css where a percentage of 13 kB is noise. Enough for honest growth, tight enough that a new dependency trips it.
First baselined 2026-08-31 at D12.1 (js 140051 / css 13545 / entry 128337) on the app's first build: the router, the token sheet, the five @fontsource stylesheets and two namespaces in two locales.

RAISED 2026-08-31 at D12.5, the second time the mechanism has stopped a step and asked for a number. js 168782 -> 207136 and entry 159851 -> 162274: the shell arrives, and with it lucide-react, the sidebar and dropdown-menu primitives, Radix's menu and its dismissable-layer/focus-scope stack, and @repo/ui's AppShell. Almost all of the +38 kB lands in the _dashboard chunk rather than in the entry — entry moved 2.4 kB, which is what 'the shell is behind the guard' looks like from here, and is the code split doing its job.
css 13592 -> 13733 on the same step: the sidebar's and the popover's utilities over a token sheet that already carried them. The budget was not raised with it; 15100 still leaves ~10%.
entry is no longer nearly the whole js figure — D12.2's note said it was, and the shell is what separated them. D12.6 (forms, @repo/form, the query client) is the next raise this file expects.
RAISED 2026-08-31 at D12.6, which is the raise the line above predicted by name — the third time the mechanism has stopped a step. js 207136 -> 264744 and entry 162274 -> 195570.

The +33 kB on the entry is the honest cost of two app-root decisions rather than of the account screens: ADR-0034 gives one query client to the whole app and mounts one <Toaster> on the root route, so @tanstack/react-query and sonner are both paid before anything renders — and ADR-0046 §13 has `create-app-i18n` compose @repo/form's catalogues and bind the zod locale installer at init, which pulls the installer into the entry with them. None of the three can move behind the guard without moving a decision with it.

The other +24 kB is behind the guard, where it should be: the change-password dialog's Radix dialog and @repo/ui's RecordSurface land in a shared chunk with the sheet, and react-hook-form, @hookform/resolvers and @repo/form's frame land with the account routes. An anonymous visitor downloads none of it — what the entry costs is the paragraph above, and the guard is what holds the rest back.
css 13733 -> 13803, seventy bytes: the card, separator and skeleton utilities over a token sheet that already carried nearly all of them. The budget was not raised with it; 15100 still leaves ~9%.

The woff2/woff files @fontsource emits are assets and are NOT counted here — a browser downloads only the subsets its text needs, so what the css number prices is the @font-face declarations, not the faces.

NOT RAISED at D12.7, and that is worth recording as loudly as a raise: the Preferences section, the settings entity and its coalescing writer, the three controls and SettingsProvider all landed inside the numbers D12.6 set. js 264744 -> 267409 (+2.7 kB) and css 13803 -> 13901; the section itself is three lucide icons and a native radio group, and both of the primitives it draws on were already paid for.

entry 195570 -> 199958 (+4.4 kB) is the composition root growing rather than the screens: app/index.tsx now mounts SettingsProvider, which pulls entities/settings and the theme, locale and density contexts in above the router. That is ADR-0045 The-client deciding where the gate sits, not a screen leaking into the entry — and it leaves entry at about 5% of headroom, which is the number D12.8 should expect to be measured against.

NOT RAISED at D12.8, measured against exactly that ~5%: js 267409 -> 268655 (+1.2 kB), css 13901 -> 14038 (+137 bytes), entry 199958 -> 200558 (+600 bytes). The deletion flow is a second AppFormDialog over a one-field form, and every part of it — Radix's dialog, RecordSurface, react-hook-form, @repo/form's frame — was paid for by D12.6's change-password dialog and lands in the same guarded chunks.

The +600 bytes on the entry are the one part worth naming, because nothing about deletion renders before the guard: they are the en `profile` catalogue, which ADR-0046 §3 bundles eagerly so the app has a language before any lazy import resolves. Copy is the one thing this app can add to the entry from behind the guard, and the deletion card and dialog are deliberately wordy — four consequence sentences that ADR-0028's semantics require somebody to read. That is the trade, stated rather than absorbed: entry headroom is ~5% still (10.4 kB), and D12.9's lv sweep costs nothing here because only `en` is eager.

RECONCILED at D12.11, and there was nothing to reconcile: D12.9 recorded the customer bundle measuring ~5-6 kB smaller than the baseline below at the same commit, with no step in between to explain it, and left the question open because answering it meant finding out which of the two builds was stale. Neither was. The two figures are one measurement in two units - `baseline` here is raw gzipped BYTES, and scripts/size.mjs prints kB as bytes/1024. 268655 bytes is 262.4 kB as the script prints it and 268.7 kB if you divide by 1000, which is how D12.8's prose quoted it; 268.7 minus 262.4 is exactly the 6.3 kB gap D12.9 saw.

Re-measured at D12.11 on a full gate build, in bytes, against the D12.8 baseline: js 268655 -> 268806 (+151), css 14038 -> 13948 (-90), entry 200558 -> 200363 (-195). That is D12.9's Banner and its two catalogue sentences against gzip and chunk-boundary noise, every row under a tenth of a kilobyte - no drift, no stale dist, nothing to raise. NOT RAISED at D12.9, D12.10 or D12.11, and the baseline below is left at D12.8 because moving it 151 bytes would say a step spent something it did not.
The lesson this file can act on: quote the three rows `pnpm size` PRINTS (kB, bytes/1024) or the bytes this file STORES, and never convert between them by eye.

NOT RAISED at D14.8, and the css row is the one worth reading: this step put @repo/form's utilities into this app's CSS for the first time (the @source lines D12.6 never added) and the number did not move — js 265.6 / css 13.6 / entry 199.1 kB against 279.3 / 14.7 / 206.1. The entry's +1.9 kB is the error boundary and its crash surface, which pulls @repo/ui's Button above the router. Almost every class @repo/form uses was already in the sheet through @repo/ui or this app's own source; `gap-5` was the one that was not, and one utility is bytes rather than kilobytes. That is the shape of the defect ADR-0062 §1 describes: invisible in a total, and visible on screen as a 20px field stack that was not there.

SHAPE CHANGED at D14.9 (ADR-0062 §4): `chunks` joins `budgets` and `baseline.chunks` joins `baseline`, one ceiling per vendor chunk `vite.config.ts` names, and `scripts/size.mjs` fails on any of them. Three chunks here against the admin's four — this app draws no grid, so @tanstack/table-* is not in its tree.

The entry fell 199.1 -> 103.2 kB on that step and js moved +672 bytes: `manualChunks` moved React, the router and the query client out of the entry into three cacheable chunks. Nothing was removed; the same bytes now live in files whose content-hash changes when the dependency does rather than when this app does.
entry's budget is 111.3 kB and may not be raised past 60% of the js budget — `size.mjs` enforces that arithmetic rather than trusting this note.

RAISED at D15.5, the fourth time the mechanism has stopped a step and asked for a number, and it stopped it by 90 bytes: js 286090 against a 286000 budget (286047 after the review pass, re-measured and recorded below). Measured in the bytes this file stores: js 272646 -> 286047 (+13.1 kB), css 13973 -> 14001 (+28 bytes), entry 105712 -> 107950 (+2.2 kB); the three vendor chunks are unmoved to the byte except router 27349 -> 27351, which is the route tree gaining two entries.

The entry's +2.2 kB is the part worth naming, because nothing about an organization renders before the guard: it is the eager `en` organizations catalogue, which ADR-0046 §3 bundles so the app has a language before any lazy import resolves — the same trade D12.8's note records for the profile catalogue, and the reason copy is the one thing this app can add to the entry from behind the guard. Entry headroom after it is ~5% (6.1 kB) against an unchanged 114000, and the 60%-of-js rule `size.mjs` enforces is nowhere near binding.

301000 rather than a rounder number: it is ~5% over the new baseline, which is the headroom this file has actually run at since D12.6 rather than the ~8% the note above inherited from the admin. A new dependency still trips it.

RAISED at D18.9, the fifth time the mechanism has stopped a step and asked for a number — and the first time it has done so after eight steps of one deliverable landed inside the number before it. js 302218 against a 301000 budget: over by 1218 bytes, which `pnpm size` prints as 295.1 kB against 293.9. The raise is js 301000 -> 317000 and nothing else; css and entry and the three vendor chunks are untouched.

What D18 spent, since a raise has to say. The D15.5 baseline below was 286047 and nothing raised it through D18.1–D18.8: address verification (the check-your-mail screen, /verify-email and its resend), password recovery (/forgot-password and /reset-password), and the invitation landing (/invitations/accept with its three states) all arrived inside the 301000 this file already carried, leaving 0.7 kB of headroom at D18.8. This step is the smallest of the four screens and the one that went over: the change-address dialog on /account/profile, the /confirm-email screen the mailed link lands on, and their copy in both locales — about 2.0 kB of the 16.2 kB D18 has added in total.

Nothing here was fixable by moving bytes, and it is worth saying why rather than leaving it to be re-litigated. `js` is every JavaScript byte the build emits, so a lazy route or a shared chunk changes which file a byte lives in and not whether it is counted — the house patterns that fix an `entry` breach do nothing for this row. What the step adds is a form over primitives this app already draws and a page over `AuthLayout`, both behind the code split already; the only lever left was copy, and the copy is the flow (ADR-0071 §6's screen has to say that nothing has changed yet, which is the one thing a reader could otherwise get wrong).

317000 rather than a rounder number: ~5% over the new baseline, which is the rule the D15.5 note above set and the headroom this file has run at since D12.6. Measured in the bytes this file stores: js 286047 -> 302218 (+16.2 kB across all of D18), css 14001 -> 14004 (+3 bytes), entry 107950 -> 110565 (+2.6 kB, the eager `en` catalogues ADR-0046 §3 bundles before any lazy import resolves — the trade D12.8's note records). The three vendor chunks are unmoved but for router 27351 -> 27382, which is the route tree gaining four entries.

**Operator-visible**: this is the number to look at if D19 (Google sign-in) or anything after it goes over again. Entry headroom is ~3% (3.4 kB) against an unchanged 114000, which is tighter than js and is what the next customer-app step should expect to be measured against; the 60%-of-js rule `size.mjs` enforces is nowhere near binding at 317000.

RAISED at D20.2 — the wave of minor and patch updates ADR-0073 §7 asks for, and the raise is the mechanism working rather than a concession. Nothing about either app changed in this step: what moved is the versions under it, taken to the latest each manifest's range already allowed so `pnpm outdated -r` is left with only D21's four majors.

The one row worth naming is `react`, which is the same chunk in both apps: 60419 -> 69054 (+8.6 kB, +14%). React 19.2.8 -> 19.3.0 is the whole of it, and it is why both budget files are being edited in a step that touched no component. The rest of the growth is spread across zod 4.4.3 -> 4.6.5, lucide-react 1.33 -> 1.47, the three @tanstack packages and react-hook-form 7.85 -> 7.88 — each a few kilobytes, none of them a decision this repository makes.

Every new ceiling is ~5% over the measurement beside it, which is the headroom rule both files have run at since D14.9 and which ADR-0073 §5 is about to make `scripts/size.mjs` enforce at D20.9 (ceiling at most 15% over baseline, re-measured in the diff that raises it). Nothing here is near that cap, and the 60%-of-js rule on the entry is nowhere near binding.

Measured in the bytes this file stores, against the D19.5 baseline: js 309767 -> 327012 (+17.2 kB), css 14026 -> 14026 (to the byte), entry 111879 -> 120324 (+8.4 kB), and the chunks query 10591 -> 10376, react 60419 -> 69054, router 27382 -> 27491. css did not move at all, which is what "no component changed" looks like from here; the entry's +8.4 kB is React and the query client, both of which this app pays above the router.

**Operator-visible**: the headroom D19.5's note said was down to 2% is restored — js 5.2%, entry 5.5%, react 5.7%. The next customer-app step is D20.9, which lowers the entry ceiling rather than raising it: the `lv` catalogue moves behind the i18next backend there, and the baseline below is what that step re-measures against.

RE-BASELINED at D20.9 (ADR-0073 §5), and the first time a ceiling in this file has gone DOWN — the lowering the D20.2 note above said this step would bring. Measured in the bytes this file stores, against the D20.2 baseline: js 327012 -> 327635 (+623), css 14026 -> 14075 (+49 bytes, D20.8's reduced-motion rule), entry 120324 -> 107600 (-12.7 kB, -10.6%), the three vendor chunks unmoved to the byte. The entry ceiling is 127000 -> 113000, ~5% over the new measurement; js and css keep their ceilings, ~5% and ~7% over what they measure.

What left the entry: react-hook-form (35 kB of source) and `@repo/form`'s field adapters with the Radix primitives they draw. This app's composition root imports `@repo/form` for three things — the namespace, the zod installer and its readiness gate — through the package's barrel, and until this step the barrel's other exports travelled with them: a barrel import keeps every re-exported module in the graph, and each one's top-level `forwardRef`/`createContext` calls counted as side effects. `@repo/form` and `@repo/grid` now declare `sideEffects: false` (nothing in either runs anything on import — `packages/app-kit`'s composition test asserts the declaration), so Rollup keeps the three exports and drops the rest. The form machinery is still paid, once, behind the guard, in the account routes' chunk where D12.6 said it lands.

What is still in the entry is the list the D12.6 note wrote: zod, axios, i18next, sonner and tailwind-merge, plus the eager `en` catalogues — every one an app-root decision (ADR-0034's one query client and root `<Toaster>`, ADR-0046 §13's zod locale bound at init, ADR-0046 §3's eager source locale). None moves without moving a decision, and this step moves none. The `lv` catalogue was never here: it has loaded through `resourcesToBackend` since D12.1 inherited the admin's factory, one chunk per `<locale>/<namespace>.json` (`account-<hash>.js`, `home-<hash>.js` and their siblings beside `lv-<hash>.js`, zod's own map).

The rule this file now runs under (ADR-0073 §5): every ceiling is at most 15% over the baseline beside it, and `scripts/size.mjs` — one script at the repository root since this step, addressed by the directory Turbo runs it in, in place of the copy this app carried — refuses the file otherwise. `scripts/size.test.mjs` reads this file and asserts the rule holds on the committed numbers.

RE-BASELINED at D21.3 — Vite 8, which bundles with Rolldown in place of Rollup, and nothing about the app changed. Measured in the bytes this file stores, against a cold Vite 7 build of the same tree (not the D20.9 baseline, which D20-D28 had already moved): js 328261 -> 316230, css 14075 -> 14047, entry 106429 -> 108460, and the chunks query 10376 -> 10123, react 69054 -> 67388, router 27491 -> 26286. Rolldown's minifier and runtime are what the smaller totals are; every vendor chunk holds the same packages it held under Rollup (`vite.config.ts`'s ranked groups).

THE ENTRY ROW CHANGED ITS FILE SET, not its meaning. Rolldown moves a module the entry shares with a lazy route into a common chunk that dist/index.html preloads, where Rollup kept it in the entry — so the entry *file* fell to about a third of what it was (37.7 kB gzipped) while nothing left the first paint. `scripts/size.mjs` now prices the module script plus every non-vendor chunk the page preloads (under Rollup the page preloaded only vendor chunks, so on a Vite 7 build the two definitions give the same number). The Vite 7 figure above is that single file; the rise is the price of the split — per-chunk import and export boilerplate and the runtime chunk, gzipped file by file.

Every ceiling is set again at ~5% over the measurement beside it (5.0% to 5.7%), the rule this file has run at since D14.9 — most of them DOWN, because Rolldown's bundle is smaller and a ceiling left where it was would sit up to 14% over its baseline, one step from ADR-0073 §5's 15% cap and loose enough to hide real growth. Totals: js 344000 -> 332000, css 15100 -> 14800, entry 113000 -> 114000 (from 4.2% of headroom). Chunks: query 11500 -> 10700, react 73000 -> 70800, router 29600 -> 27600. The 60%-of-js rule on the entry is nowhere near binding.

RE-BASELINED at D21.7, D21's close-out, so that the baseline is the shipping commit's measurement (the plan's definition of done, item 5). Two cold builds of the close-out tree agree to the byte: js 316230 -> 316214 (-16 bytes), entry 108460 -> 108440 (-20 bytes); css and every vendor chunk unmoved to the byte. No app source and no runtime package moved after D21.3; the one input under the app that did is D21.5's `@repo/typescript-config` presets, which Vite 8's transform reads, and the cause was not isolated further. No ceiling changes: each ceiling now sits a few bytes further above its baseline (5.0% on js, 5.1% on entry), still far inside ADR-0073 §5's 15% cap.
